card.name: Section cross-reference openers in labels
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or space after "Clinical Pharmacology" in bracketed label cross-references like [see ... Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)]. Also fires on a few words that start a following clause or field in trial listings, such as "Designated" and "Study".
